title: Lang/libs coordination question: okay for libs to stabilize traits with `final fn` in them?
author: joshtriplett
body_preview: Filing this issue to get a definitive answer on whether @rust-lang/lang has any concerns about @rust-lang/libs-api stabilizing APIs in the standard library that use `final fn`.  If we stabilize such an API, that commits us to keeping this mechanism. That seems fine to me, as we have an accepted RFC and we seem to have a consistent expectation of shipping/stabilizing `final fn`.
